about: Product clips the video needs, recorded by scripts/record.mjs against the live site at 1920x1080 with a visible cursor. Files land in public/footage/<id>.mp4 (gitignored). 'marks' are filled in by the recorder: seconds into the clip where each action happens, so scenes can line up actions with beats.

home.what: Decisions page: the region map, decision cards with countdowns; type a street; click the 2027 budget card

overview.what: Decision brief, Overview tab: plain summary, reading grade, review status

source.what: Click a figure: the source viewer opens on its PDF page with the quote highlighted

affects.what: Affects you: tap Renter and Transit rider; cited impacts appear

ask-opinion.what: Ask 'Should I support this budget or oppose it?': the recorded answer (after ~3 s) lays out both sides and does not take one; replay label visible

say.what: Have your say: timeline, next chance with countdown, how to take part, Add to calendar

ask.what: Ask: type exactly 'How much of my regional tax bill goes to public transit?'; a real run replays from the record (plan, specialist steps, checked statements, ~8 s), then the answer with 'Answered by the agents on <time> · replayed from the record'. Recorded at 1x, sped up 2x

transit.what: Transit lens: gaps and destinations on the map, time-of-day switch, first/last mile, ranked fixes

costs.what: Cost lens: stacked lifecycle chart; drag a slider; per household recomputes; discount toggle

commitments.what: Commitments lens: status pills; expand one; what's still unclear

housing.what: Housing lens: units by stage, approval to completion; untracked stages

unknowns.what: Unknowns & trade-offs: what the documents don't answer, who can; trade-offs both ways; harms. Slow scroll

staff-draft.what: Staff: passcode, pick row-2027-budget, start the brief as a replay of the agents' real run (labelled 'Replay of the agents' real run on <time>'); the agents panel; statements checked; any rejected quote. Sped up 4x. LOCAL ONLY: recorded against a throwaway copy of the data on http://127.0.0.1:4199 (scripts/staff-server.sh), never the live site

staff-review.what: Staff review: approve, edit with a note, reject; reviewer name; Publish; public page shows Approved by. LOCAL ONLY: recorded against a throwaway copy of the data on http://127.0.0.1:4199 (scripts/staff-server.sh), never the live site

log.what: Record: the log newest first; the chain check runs: Chain intact

spend.what: Spend: calls, tokens, US$, energy and CO2e, daily limit

language.what: Language menu: the brief switches to another language

a11y.what: Keyboard only: tabbing through the brief with visible focus rings

scout-map.what: Construction tab on row-2027-budget: the map with ranked candidate launch and extraction sites, the 2.9 km twin bores under Highway 401 and the Speed River, 49 boreholes, 11 cross-passages

scout-section.what: Construction tab: the long-section ('Under the ground') with the animated TBM

scout-steps.what: Construction tab: stepping 1 to 7; each step flies the map and shows its render (spare, if we cut to it instead of the stills)

dark.what: The brief in dark mode, 2x screenshot

phone.what: The brief on a phone (390x844, 3x), screenshot

readiness.what: The Municipal Readiness Report, page 1, rendered from report/*.pdf

scout-renders.what: The construction scout's seven stage renders, copied from data/renders by npm run gen (real product files, no recording needed)
